title: EASY OPEN, BUT HAS LOCK TO PREVENT ACCIDENTAL OPENING; ATTRACTIVE
text: EASY OPEN, BUT HAS LOCK TO PREVENT ACCIDENTAL OPENING; ATTRACTIVE. This is the second drink bottle that I have acquired recently.  The first one was a different brand and it was okay, but hard to open to get a drink.  This one has a nice push button so the top pops open easily.  It also has a locking mechanism so that it doesn't accidentally pop open and spill.  The bottle is an attractive black with some nice finger grooves for easy holding.  Overall very well constructed and I like it a lot.

product_metadata.title: Kyocera 17oz. Ceramic Coated Interior, Double Wall Vacuum Insulated, Stainless Steel Travel Mug-Matt Black
features: NEVER COMPROMISE FLAVOR: The ceramic interior will never impact the taste of your beverage and will never rust.
VERSATILE ON-THE-GO MUG: The wide opening of the mug can be filled with ice cubes or snack food you want to insulate.
COMPACT, YET EFFICIENT: The double-wall, vacuum-insulated, slim, compact mug easily travels with you and will keep your beverage hot or cold for hours.
STAINLESS STEEL EXTERIOR: Stays cool to the touch with hot liquids and never sweats with cold liquids.
ECOLOGICALLY-FRIENDLY: Take this everywhere and refill as needed to help reduce waste and one-time use containers.
description: Kyocera introduces the perfect companion for commuting to the office, school, attending outdoor activities, or just relaxing at home. Whether you're an all-day coffee, tea, or water drinker, or a morning smoothie lover, this thoughtfully designed travel mug is spill-proof. Release the safety lock with one touch, and enjoy your beverage at any time! The slim exterior design is easy to grip, and the ceramic-coated interior keeps liquids hot or cold for at least 6 hours to 12 hours depending on the starting temperature.
